Unresolved information

  • No atomic coordinates, CIF, unit-cell constants, occupancy refinement, interface lattice mapping or crystallographic atom model is supplied. SAED establishes author phase assignments only.
  • No XRD pattern, Raman spectrum, electrical transport or elemental spatial map is supplied. XRF must not be relabeled XRD or EDS.
  • Samples are explicitly labeled 1–4 and figures identify those stages. Exact batch/aliquot provenance, microscopy transfer/isolation details, and whether TEM, SAED, magnetometry and optical measurements used the same physical batch are unreported.
  • Reaction vessel, heating apparatus, numeric inert pressure, gas identity, ramp rates and stirring speeds are not reported. Dioctyl-ether boiling point is not numerically supplied.
  • CdCl2 hydration and 80.5% assay basis are unresolved. Recrystallization solvent ratio/amount/temperature, vacuum pressure and drying duration are absent. Purity and hydration of isolated Cd(acac)2 are not analytically quantified.
  • Centrifugation force/speed/time, yield or final mass of 4, final particle concentration and nitrogen storage temperature/duration are absent.
  • Instrument models, TEM voltage, XRF source/substrate/calibration, magnetic sample mass/state, full FC/ZFC protocol, SI-3 field, optical concentration and fluorescence correction details are absent.
  • Core–shell intermediates and dewetting mechanism remain author-supported interpretations with an isolation limitation; no separately varied annealing study, in situ kinetics or interface thermodynamic parameters are supplied.
  • No synthesis replicate count, error bars, numerical dispersity, failed-isolation trial count or raw data files are provided in the supplied bundle.

Source distinctions and conflicts

  • SI inset mol% values Fe 0.0562, Pt 0.0604, Cd 1.5447, S 1.9262 do not directly reproduce the main stated approximate Fe/Pt/Cd/S ratio 1:1:3:3.6. Corrections, substrate contribution and quantification basis are not supplied. Preserve both representations; do not silently rescale either.
